claims.summary: In a three-state Boolean degree-D pseudoideal, a degree-e error tuple with e+K<=D and r independent common affine annihilators not spanning 1 has exact input-degree level j at most the coefficient of z^j in (1+2z)^((m-r)+)(1+z)^min(r,2m-r). For K<m/4 and r<=m, these caps cannot certify the intrinsic shadow sufficient harmonic regime rho<=1+1/delta. For r>m and q=2m-r>=K a certifying X in that regime exists exactly when q<=2K-delta+1+(K-delta+1)/delta. Complementary Boolean hyperplanes in every dimension show separate image level counts cannot generally be added for their sum.
